scope: One fixed full-navigation integration check before DART150; independent output, not a new benchmark.
selection: First episode in the existing frozen first-batch manifest; selected by order, without outcome filtering.
backend: LMDeploy0.11.1 PyTorch; float16; eager; context4096; maxprefill3072; fixed64 KV blocks of64; no prefix cache
invalid_output_policy: record error, execute STOP; count every fixed episode in denominator
model_inputs: Author policy: RGB-only current and up to eight historical observations, uniformly sampled from last200. No action text, motion feedback, target truth or self-written memory.
horizon_note: 400 primitive actions includingSTOP; no collision early termination or policy changes
action_parser: Author parser/action chunking: first two subcommands, at most3 primitive actions each; detect random fallback and mark failed STOP; no silent random action
differences_from_author_benchmark: Habitat0.1.7/LMDeploy; FP16 with multi-image exact-budget DART; one-episode integration check
pre_registered: First episode in the existing frozen 150-case subset; no outcome filtering; does not modify prior results.
source_precision: Original unquantized checkpoint cast to FP16; layer-internal DART keeps 75% image tokens; no AWQ or KV quantization
execution_gate: Run only after a nine-image navigation-profile request has passed actual token/cache/mRoPE evidence checks.
